name: sales
about: Simulated WhatsApp chats for the Sales agent demo at Beyond the Limits, a made-up football boot store: 300 chats over two weeks that end in an order or go quiet. Not real data. A chat with no order ends with chat_closed, as a live chat that closes after quiet does (no timer settles a case, DECISIONS item 66).

detail.heard: Which sizes do you have in the Vapor 17 Elite?
Can you print my name on the boots?
What is the difference between Elite, Pro and Academy?
Which colours do the boots come in?
Are the boots the same as in the photo?
How do I know my size?

detail.said: Asked which size they usually wear before the summary.

lift.lesson: Before you send the summary, ask the buyer what size they normally wear.
